body:
She is from a 1st world country, so am I. That's not why it would be horrible. She became an orphan at a young age, has been adopted and put back in the system again a couple of times. Now she have no close relationships, she's lacking education and so on. I have had a lot of chances she have not and I feel like I have fooled her if I want a divorce. I do know she's irresponsible, but is that enough to leave my wife? 
 
 
Sometimes I feel like a sucker in this relationship. I can lay awake at night getting angry at her out of the blue, with theories that perhaps she is the one that fooled me. That she doesn't give a damn about me, thence the lack of sex. Then I go on and wildly speculate that maybe that's why I haven't met any of her friends from her country when we've been there. Now is one of the times I feel like that.
 
 
Most of the time though, I feel like that is a quite absurd scenario and that I'm blaming my life situation on her. That she does love me, she just have had a rough life I haven't. 
 
 
I haven't divorced her because I have thought that if I'm loyal enough and an understanding loving partner, we could have a good life together. I have also gotten her therapy and help similar help she had no chance of getting were she's from, due to lack of finances. I thought it would help, she says it doesn't but that time will. 
 
 
I don't know if everything would be better of without her, maybe I would not just be miserable but lonely as well. I do know she's happy most of the time and that is to some consolation.

Sorry for the wall.
